chapter: Early listening, piano and adolescent conflict
title: Paul Whiteman and the Mills Brothers imitating horns
summary: Classical music and Paul Whiteman were heard at home; the Mills Brothers were high-class entertainers who imitated horns.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Growing up with radio, records and family listening

blocks.x: You know? And so there again you have a discipline of music that I was hearing, which was associated with classical music, and of course my mother was appreciative of classical music. And the music that I heard on the radio naturally had to be music that was fitting -- befitting of the atmosphere in our home. It was a very serene atmosphere. So I heard the classical music, and I remember hearing Paul Whiteman, see.
So all this joins up with my later interest in jazz. The Mills Brothers I didn't consider to be completely jazz. They were high class entertainers.
And I remember they used to imitate the horns.
